parsed.why: State-directed targeting: police routinely detain, extort, coerce and prosecute trans women; forced examinations amounting to torture; entrenched impunity; no lawful recourse or advocacy channel. Worst documented tier is state-tolerated targeting with torture.
Enforced morality statute (2022, 2024 convictions), deep stigma and zero recourse, but no documented police targeting of trans people and no prosecutions in 2023. Exposure episodic, not systematic.

No criminalisation, no documented targeting or violence, functioning civil-law institutions. Negatives are resident-facing (no marker change) or dated LGB conservatism; frontier document mismatch is the only trans-adjacent friction.

No criminalisation, constitutional equality guarantee since 2018, only dated stigma recorded; no documented police, border or violence exposure. Very thin record, so held below the acceptance-with-protections tier.

No criminalisation and courts granting relief, but documented public harassment of visibly trans people, discrimination in government institutions, and rising political hostility with death threats; broken document-recognition implementation leaves thin recourse.
